author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I think I finally came out on the other side of the post AI economy as I on the path to fully automated 80% of my job.

Human still have jobs, AI (at least this generation, the LLM) can't replace human totally.   There is an equilibrium on the other side.  It is scary during the transition because the slope of productivity suddenly jump from 1 to 10.  After you have reached the other side, the speed is much faster but it is no longer accelerating.

It just feels like the same, you are as busy as before, work doesn't disappear, it never ends, but you produce a lot more.
